# Teamwork Graph CLI

> Public documentation, release notes, bundled public agent skills, and issue
> tracking for Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI (`twg`).

## Documentation

- [Installation and upgrade](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/twg-cli/getting-started/installation/)
- [Stable command catalog](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/twg-cli/commands/commands-catalog/)
- [Agent skills guide](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/twg-cli/agents/skills/)
- [Plugin installation](https://github.com/atlassian-labs/twg-plugins)
- [Public changelog](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/twg-cli/changelog/)
- [Stable release manifest](https://teamwork-graph.atlassian.com/cli/manifest.json)
